description: This source file implements a GStreamer video sink element for Rialto, handling media source creation, state changes, property management, and event handling for video streaming within Rialto's media pipeline.

classes.name: RialtoMSEVideoSink
classes.description: A GStreamer sink element for Rialto that handles video media streaming, including property management, event handling, and media source creation.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_change_state
methods.description: Handles state transitions for the Rialto video sink, attaching media player clients and configuring stream info during state changes.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_create_media_source
methods.description: Creates a media source object based on the provided GstCaps, determining the appropriate media source type and MIME type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_event
methods.description: Handles GstPad events, particularly CAPS events, to attach media sources to the pipeline.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as video rectangle, maximum video dimensions, and frame stepping status.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties such as video rectangle, maximum video dimensions, and frame stepping status, and triggers frame rendering if needed.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_qos_handle
methods.description: Handles Quality of Service (QoS) events, posting QoS messages to the GStreamer bus.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoMSEVideoSink instance, setting up sink pads and callback functions.

methods.name: rialto_mse_video_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization for the RialtoMSEVideoSink, setting up properties, capabilities, and class details.
